backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the ToolShare backend, defining types (UserProfile, ToolListing, RentalRequest, ChatMessage) and managing state for profiles, tools, rentals, and chats with access control and HTTP outcall support.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting a high-confidence fix for zoom-level errors on the community map, targeting CustomMapView, useMapTiles, and useMapTransform to support zoom up to level 19 without broken tiles.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing short summaries of each frontend source file, describing the purpose and key implementation details of pages, components, hooks, and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for the design system's color tokens in both light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Vite-based frontend, setting the page title to 'ToolShare - Community Tool Sharing Platform' and mounting the React app via src/main.tsx.
frontend/README.md: Minimal README for the ToolShare frontend, identifying it as a community tool-sharing platform built on the Internet Computer with a Getting Started section.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes (browse, listings, rentals, messaging, profile, community map) and wraps the app in ThemeProvider and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button component using Internet Identity, showing loading state during authentication and clearing the React Query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/auth/RequireAuth: Auth guard component that renders a login prompt card when the user is unauthenticated, otherwise renders its children.
frontend/src/components/community/Commun: Community map panel combining a CustomMapView with a member list sidebar, supporting member selection to display an info card overlay and filtering members to those with coordinates.
frontend/src/components/community/Custom: A custom interactive map component using OpenStreetMap tiles that renders community member markers, supports pan/zoom via pointer and wheel events, and auto-fits the viewport to member locations.
Renders a teardrop-shaped SVG map pin for a community member, displaying their profile picture or initials, with color and size variations for selected/current-user states.
frontend/src/components/community/SetCoo: A dialog that accepts a street address, geocodes it via Nominatim, and saves the resulting coordinates to the user's profile using the updateProfile mutation.
frontend/src/components/landing/Floating: A full-screen canvas animation layer that renders drifting 3D-style floating objects (orbs, rings, faceted shapes, tori) with parallax, wobble, and pulse effects, respecting reduced-motion preferences.
frontend/src/components/landing/Interact: A wrapper component that applies a 3D perspective tilt transform and radial highlight on mouse hover, disabled for touch devices and users who prefer reduced motion.
frontend/src/components/landing/LandingI: A thin wrapper around an HTML img element that enforces alt text, applies default lazy loading, and ensures responsive sizing for landing page illustrations.
A landing page section that displays a two-column layout with marketing copy, savings stats, and a hero illustration image for the tool-sharing community.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppFooter: A simple footer component displaying a copyright notice and a link to caffeine.ai with a heart icon.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: Sticky top navigation header with the ToolShare logo, responsive nav links (shown based on auth state), a login button or profile menu, and a mobile slide-out sheet menu.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Root layout wrapper that composes AppHeader, a flex-growing main content area, and AppFooter around child content.
frontend/src/components/layout/PageHeade: Reusable page-level heading component that renders a title, optional subtitle, and optional action buttons in a flex row.
frontend/src/components/layout/PageShell: Simple container wrapper that applies consistent horizontal padding and vertical spacing to page content.
frontend/src/components/listings/BrowseF: Filter bar for the browse page with controlled inputs for text search, category, sort order, min/max price, and an availability toggle.
frontend/src/components/listings/CameraC: Camera UI panel that starts the device camera on mount, shows a live video preview, and emits a JPEG data URL on capture; handles unsupported/permission/error states.
frontend/src/components/listings/Listing: Responsive grid of tool listing cards showing photo, title, category badge, description, location, and an unavailable overlay; links each card to its detail page.
frontend/src/components/listings/OwnerAc: Dropdown menu visible only to the listing owner with options to navigate to the edit page or toggle the listing's availability via a mutation.
frontend/src/components/listings/PhotoRe: Form field for managing a list of tool photos, supporting URL entry, removal, and camera capture via a dialog-hosted CameraCapturePanel.
frontend/src/components/messaging/Active: Displays the active conversation panel for a selected rental, showing tool info, rental dates, status badge, and the chat panel. Falls back to an empty state prompt when no rental is selected.
frontend/src/components/messaging/Conver: Renders a scrollable list of rental conversations, each showing tool title, other user's role/name, and status badge, with selection highlighting.
frontend/src/components/navigation/AppNa: A styled navigation link component wrapping TanStack Router's Link with active/inactive color classes.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileM: Dropdown menu component showing the authenticated user's avatar, display name, and options to view their profile or log out.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: Modal dialog that prompts newly authenticated users without a profile to create one by entering display name, contact info, location, and address.
frontend/src/components/rentals/RentalCh: Chat panel for a rental that loads and displays messages, distinguishes own vs. other messages visually, and allows sending new messages via textarea with Enter key support.
frontend/src/components/rentals/RentalRe: Form component for submitting a rental request for a tool, with start/end date inputs, validation, and navigation to the rentals page on success.
frontend/src/components/rentals/RentalSt: Renders action buttons (Approve/Decline, Cancel, Complete) for a rental based on the current status and whether the user is the owner or renter, with confirmation dialogs and toast notifications on status update.
frontend/src/components/states/EmptyStat: Displays a centered card with an icon, title, description, and optional action button to represent an empty state.
frontend/src/components/states/ErrorStat: Displays a destructive-styled card with an alert icon, title, description, and optional action button to represent an error state.
frontend/src/components/states/LoadingSt: Renders a centered spinner with an optional message to indicate a loading state.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, initializing it with the current Internet Identity and invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context with login, logout, and status tracking via AuthClient, exposing a hook and provider component for use throughout the app.
frontend/src/hooks/useMapTiles.ts: Calculates the set of map tiles needed to fill a viewport given a center coordinate and zoom level, and provides a lat/lng-to-pixel conversion function using Web Mercator math with CartoDB tile URLs.
frontend/src/hooks/useMapTransform.ts: Manages map pan and zoom state with pointer drag handling, zoom in/out controls, and coordinate sanitization, returning transform state and event handlers for a map container.
frontend/src/hooks/useMapZoom.ts: Provides zoom state management with zoomIn, zoomOut, reset, and mouse wheel handler functions, configurable with min/max zoom and step options.
frontend/src/hooks/useParallaxMotion.ts: Tracks mouse position and scroll offset to produce parallax motion values, respecting the user's reduced-motion preference.
frontend/src/hooks/usePrefersReducedMoti: Returns a boolean indicating whether the user has requested reduced motion via the OS/browser media query, updating reactively on changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for all backend actor calls including user profiles, tool listings, rental requests, chat messages, and community map profiles, with appropriate cache invalidation on mutations.
frontend/src/hooks/useWebGLSupport.ts: Custom hook that checks WebGL availability in the browser by attempting to create a canvas context, returning support status, loading state, and any error message.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up Tailwind CSS, defines CSS custom properties for light/dark theme color tokens, and adds utility classes for 3D transforms, landing page textures, and reduced-motion overrides.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/BrowseListingsPage.ts: Page component for browsing tool listings with filter/search state (text, category, price range, availability, sort) passed to a filters bar and a listings grid.
frontend/src/pages/CommunityMapPage.tsx: Page that displays a map of community members' locations, requiring authentication, and allows users to add or update their own coordinates via a dialog.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Marketing landing page with a hero section, floating 3D objects, how-it-works steps, and feature highlights, with navigation to browse or list tools based on authentication state.
frontend/src/pages/ListingDetailPage.tsx: Detail page for a single tool listing showing photos, category, condition, pricing, and location, with owner-specific actions and a rental request form for other authenticated users.
frontend/src/pages/ListingFormPage.tsx: A form page for creating or editing tool listings, with fields for title, category, description, condition, pricing, location, availability, and photos. Supports both 'create' and 'edit' modes, pre-populating fields from existing data when editing.
frontend/src/pages/MessagingPage.tsx: Displays a messaging interface showing conversations tied to the user's rentals, with a conversations list and an active conversation panel side by side. Requires authentication and shows empty/loading states as needed.
frontend/src/pages/MyRentalsPage.tsx: Shows a grid of rental cards for tools the current user has rented, including status badges, dates, and action buttons. Requires authentication and handles loading and empty states.
frontend/src/pages/MyToolsPage.tsx: Displays the authenticated user's tool listings along with alerts for pending rental requests and active rentals. Provides navigation to add new listings and manage rental requests.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Renders the user's profile page with view and edit modes, allowing updates to display name, contact info, location, profile picture, and address. Handles URL-based edit mode activation and persists changes via a mutation hook.
frontend/src/pages/RentalDetailPage.tsx: Shows detailed information for a specific rental including tool details, dates, cost, status badge, status actions, and a chat panel. Determines owner/renter roles from the current identity to control available actions.
frontend/src/pages/RequestsPage.tsx: Displays incoming rental requests for the authenticated user's tools, rendering each request as a card with status badge, date range, and action buttons.
frontend/src/utils/fileToDataUrl.ts: Exports a single async utility function that converts a File object to a base64 data URL string using FileReader.
frontend/src/utils/geoProjection.ts: Provides utilities for equirectangular (flat map) projection, converting lat/lon coordinates to screen percentage positions and validating coordinate ranges.
frontend/src/utils/globeProjection.ts: Provides Three.js-based utilities for converting lat/lon coordinates to 3D sphere surface vectors, plus coordinate validation and parsing helpers.
frontend/src/utils/rentals/rentalDateFor: Exports date formatting functions for rental timestamps (nanosecond bigints), including short date, long date, chat-relative timestamp, and rental duration in days.
frontend/src/utils/rentals/rentalStatusP: Defines color and label mappings for all RentalStatus enum values and exports helper functions to retrieve them.
frontend/src/utils/timeOnApp.ts: Exports two functions that format a bigint join timestamp into a human-readable time-on-app duration string and a formatted join date string.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for reading URL query parameters from both regular and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence and hash cleanup helpers.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens, extended border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations for accordion and floating effects.
project_state.json: Project state metadata tracking version, known issues, and existing features; currently focused on fixing a street-level zoom error in CustomMapView.
